# Model Overview (for Diagnosis)

The probes target a masked BERT4Rec model through a ModelView wrapper. Relevant hooks are `item_emb`, `log2feats(sequence)`, and `predict_score(features, items)`; `view.model` holds the actual network. Backbone internals are not supplied here.

For user geometry, histories are truncated to `maxlen - 1`, followed by the reserved MASK token and left-padded. The final representation is selected at the maximum nonpadding index—the appended MASK position.

# Diagnosis Inputs & Hooks

`DiagnosisProbe(view, device)` accesses training histories, metadata, review-data interfaces, and the underlying module. It resolves the family-specific `sample_batch` to inspect optional corruption bookkeeping.

The loader supplies `(None, sequence, positive, negative)` tensors shaped B × L. Probes validate shapes and token ranges, extract sequence features, and request B × L × 2 positive/negative logits. Geometry and margin probes temporarily use evaluation mode and restore the prior mode.

# Probes & Metrics

- **Embedding directional alignment:** Mean off-diagonal cosine similarity among up to 2,048 sampled real-item embeddings, mapped to [0,1]. High values indicate aligned directions, but do not establish collapse.
